name: Keeper
shortDescription: Tracks expenses and files federal and state taxes. The homepage says you can get started free.
longDescription: Keeper's pricing page lists bookkeeping, federal and state filing, quarterly tax payments, and a tax pro consult. The homepage says you can get started free. That page does not list one monthly plan price.
pricingNotes: Homepage says get started free. Pricing page lists filing and quarterly taxes, not one monthly dollar price.
bestFor: Filing self-employed taxes with expense tracking and quarterly payments
notIdealFor: Someone who needs a published monthly price before signing up
strength: Keeper's pricing page lists federal and state filing plus quarterly tax payments, and the homepage says you can get started free.
weakness: The pages did not state one monthly dollar price.

useCaseFit.do-taxes: Lists federal and state tax filing, quarterly payments, and a free start on the homepage.
